get.summary: Liveness: the process is up and its database answers.
The service catalogue for the sign-up services step: categories in display order, sub-categories by name.
Suburb autocomplete for sign-up: prefix match on suburb or postcode, current rows only, at most 10.

post.summary: Whether an address can sign up (no account yet). Asked when the email field loses focus. One indexed lookup, nothing else.
Email a 6-digit code to the address the worker wants to sign up with. Answers a signed ticket; nothing is stored. The same 202 for any address.
Check a code against its ticket. The code expires 10 minutes after it was sent.
A ticket to upload the sign-up photo straight to storage: one key, one type, at most 5 MB, ten minutes. Nothing is stored until confirm.
Confirm an uploaded sign-up photo: the object is checked (size, first bytes) and only then recorded. Returns the same id, never a URL.
Create a worker account. The same 202 for a new and an existing email.

message.const: Check your inbox — if this email is new, your account is ready and you can sign in now.

get.summary: The admin worker search: every filter combined with AND, the radius from a suburb of ours computed by PostGIS, nearest first; counts the workers with no mapped suburb.
The impersonation picker: up to 50 users newest first matching an email or a profile name.
Workers whose account is suspended, most recently changed first, paged.
